To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) peer assessment is of good validity and reliability in a wide variety (e.g., of discipline, type of assignment, type of peer assessment, type of student) of application; (b) peer assessment is as effective as teacher assessment in promoting student learning and development; and (c) peer assessment is more effective in promoting student learning than no assessment at all.
peer assessment between students is a valid and reliable method of assessment that has a positive effect on student learning and achievement.
peer assessment can be an effective method to improve student achievement, and that it is as effective as teacher assessment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the assessment of students by students in higher education.
peer assessment between students, in which students assess each other’s work.
the use of peer assessment between undergraduate students in higher education.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in general, peer assessment is an effective and efficient means of assessment.
peer assessment is a viable and effective formative assessment method in higher education.

peer assessment between students is a valid and reliable method that is at least as effective as traditional assessment methods in improving student achievement and attitudes, but that more research is needed to determine its effectiveness for other applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
peer assessment is a promising method for enhancing learning and teaching in higher education.
peer assessment is an effective, efficient, and popular method of formative assessment, and it should be more widely used by higher education.
students are capable of assessing their own and each other's learning, provided the assessment tasks and the criteria for the assessment are clear and unambiguous.
The main takeaway from our work is that
peer assessment is a powerful method that can be applied in a variety of contexts in higher education.
peer assessment is a viable and valuable method of assessment in higher education, which can be implemented successfully if certain conditions are met.
peer assessment between students has the potential to make a significant contribution to the enhancement of teaching and learning in colleges and universities.
